title: papaver somniferum var. album
intro: Papaver somniferum var. album, commonly known as White Poppy, is a variety of the opium poppy plant that is cultivated for its medicinal properties and ornamental value. The health benefits of White Poppy include its ability to act as a natural pain reliever, reduce inflammation, and promote relaxation. The therapeutic actions of White Poppy include its sedative and antispasmodic effects, making it useful for treating anxiety, insomnia, and muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of White Poppy include alkaloids such as thebaine, codeine, and morphine, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
